cap.clone.planned: Planned for phase 3: no cloning engine is installed.
cap.clone.tip: Speak with a voice generated from yours.
cap.listen.tip: The mic listens and transcribes what is said.
cap.record.tip: Records your voice into the library.
cap.typespeak.tip: What you type is spoken aloud as you type.
compose.placeholder: Type here. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
demo.hint: Simulated engines: no real translation or recognition. For trying out the interface.
err.dep: Missing dependencies. Install them: pip install "relais[{extra}]"
err.mic_denied: Microphone access denied. Allow it in the browser.
err.model_kokoro: Kokoro model missing. Install it: relais pull tts --tts kokoro
err.model_mt: Translation model missing. Install it: relais pull mt
err.model_stt: Recognition model “{size}” missing. Install it: relais pull stt --stt {size}
err.model_tts: No voice installed. Install some: relais pull tts
err.no_mic_api: The mic isn't available here: it needs localhost or HTTPS.
err.resume: Tap the screen to resume listening.
folio.empty.body: Turn on Listen and Translation, then speak. Or type below: the translation writes itself as you type.
folio.empty.title: Nothing heard yet.
glossary.intro: Terms to keep as they are, or to always translate a specific way. Applied to every translation.
glossary.title: Glossary
history.title: History
lat.title: Latency
level.muted: Mic paused while the voice speaks
level.title: Mic level
library.intro: Your recordings. They will train your cloned voice (phase 3).
library.name: Name
library.tip: For a good sample: a minute or more, natural voice, quiet room, mic at a steady distance.
library.title: Voice library
set.listen.echo_guard: Pause listening while the voice speaks
set.listen.echo_guard.hint: Stops the mic from hearing the synthetic voice. Keep on with speakers.
set.listen.model.hint: Bigger = more accurate but slower. Reloads the model.
set.listen.partials.hint: Shows and translates the sentence as it goes. Turn off if the machine struggles.
set.listen.sensitivity.hint: Raise it if your voice is missed, lower it if noise triggers.
set.listen.who.hint: Auto guesses each sentence's language. Forcing one is more reliable in noise.
set.pair.me.hint: Used to tell which sentences are yours (recordings, typing).
set.perf.threads.hint: Automatic uses every core. Takes effect on next load.
set.perf.unload_when_off: Free memory when a feature is off
set.perf.unload_when_off.hint: Turning off unloads the model; turning back on reloads it.
set.record.keep_utterances.hint: Saves the audio of each sentence spoken in your language to the library.
set.speak.device.hint: Pick a virtual audio cable to send the voice into a call.
set.speak.engine.hint: Piper: very fast. Kokoro: more natural, slower. Reloads the voice.
set.speak.originals.hint: Handy to hear back what the mic understood.
set.speak.translations.hint: Each translated sentence is spoken in the other language.
set.translate.glossary.hint: Glossary terms are kept or translated as you defined.
set.type.min_words.hint: Avoids speaking a lone word after a pause.
set.type.pause_ms.hint: After this pause, finished words are spoken.
set.type.rhythm.hint: Word by word is very reactive but choppy. Phrase by phrase sounds the most natural.
set.type.say.hint: In the same language as your typing nothing is translated: the voice says what you type.
set.ui.font_text.hint: Fonts are installed with “relais pull fonts”.
set.ui.layout.hint: Automatic: two columns on wide screens, stacked on phones.
set.ui.motion.hint: Also respects your system's “reduce motion” setting.
set.ui.show_original.hint: In stacked layout, also shows the other person's language.
settings.profile.hint: A profile remembers all your settings: “Meeting”, “Call”, “Travel”…
settings.profile.name: Profile name
system.hint: To install or repair models: relais pull
system.title: System
who.title: Who is speaking
